faq.question: Do I need prior experience before joining?
faq.answer: No. The track starts with foundations and then moves into applied tasks, so beginners can build confidence step by step.

faq.question: Will I build practical projects inside this course?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum is organized around structured assignments, submissions, and reviewable outputs.

faq.question: What kind of support will I get during the program?
faq.answer: You get guided learning structure, task clarity, and review-focused feedback to help you improve your work.
